calls.title: Demo Call with Matt Carter from NABIS
calls.summary: In the meeting, the team, led by Matt Carter, discussed their immediate need for a straightforward feature flagging tool, planning to finalize their decision within one to two weeks. The current approach involves running an open-source version first to validate its fit, emphasizing self-hosting due to past pricing volatility with cloud vendors. The team confirmed that they prioritize feature flagging over experimentation, viewing the latter as a long-term goal, approximately a year away. They are also migrating to a new data warehousing solution to support analytics. Cost sensitivity is paramount, as Matt seeks clear annual pricing for the Growth Book enterprise license. Finally, deployment flexibility was deemed critical, with upcoming discussions planned to address integration and technical specifics.
calls.keywords: feature_flagging, self_hosting, enterprise_license, data_warehouse, experimentation, pricing
